title: Prime Minister shares an article highlighting India Post's transformation into a modern, technology-driven and professionally managed institution
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, today shared an article by Shri Jyotiraditya M. Scindia,  highlighting India Post's transformation into a modern, technology-driven and professionally managed institution. The article notes that India Post is combining its vast reach with digital capabilities across logistics, financial services and citizen-centric offerings.
The Prime Minister posted on X:
“In this article, Shri @JM_Scindia highlights India Post's transformation into a modern, technology-driven and professionally managed institution. He notes that India Post is combining its vast reach with digital capabilities across logistics, financial services and citizen-centric offerings. At the same time, it continues to uphold its trusted public-service role in the spirit of 'Dak Seva, Jan Seva.'
In this article, Shri @JM_Scindia highlights India Post's transformation into a modern, technology-driven and professionally managed institution.
